references.title: AI classroom learner view (preview analogy)
references.question: Q3
references.take: Captured SchoolAI editor visibly includes a dark panel labeled ‘Previewing as a student,’ with generated student content and Restart preview, direct evidence of preview availability and a reversible learner-view check.

references.title: Community space home (learner home analogy)
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured community home is an adjacent course-home analogy: orient the learner with a clear space title and content entry points above the fold; course progress and next session were not observed.

references.title: Course community home with content feed
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured home puts the community/course identity and latest content in the first view; use this as an adjacent learner-home pattern, with progress and next session needing explicit slots.

references.title: Learner course dashboard
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured Teachable learner dashboard is direct evidence for a course home: keep the current course context and the next learning action visible above the fold; confirm exact progress/material modules visually before implementation.

references.title: Learner course home
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured Coursera learner view provides direct course-home evidence; prioritize a resume/next lesson action and visible course structure, while announcements are not observed in this screenshot.

references.title: Learning dashboard with progress
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured learning dashboard is adjacent evidence for making progress salient above the fold; it does not establish shared-course announcements or instructor materials.

references.title: Learner course progress home
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured Codecademy course view supports a compact progress plus next-step hierarchy for learner home; announcements were not observed.

references.title: Mobile learner study home
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured mobile learning home is direct device evidence for a prominent resume action and lightweight progress cue; shared announcements are not observed.

references.title: Mobile course progress home
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured mobile course home keeps the next lesson and progress close together, a useful above-fold pattern; no instructor materials or announcements observed.

references.title: Mobile learner class view
references.question: Q4
references.take: Captured mobile class view is adjacent evidence for course identity plus a clear continue path; treat it as analogy because shared cohort announcements are not shown.

references.title: View as learner flow
references.question: Q3
references.take: Captured two-step flow explicitly names View as learner and shows the resulting learner-facing state, strong evidence for a low-friction preview entry and fidelity check.

references.title: Preview lesson flow
references.question: Q3
references.take: Captured six-step lesson preview flow shows preview can preserve real lesson navigation and content context; use as evidence for fidelity, with learner role labeling kept visible.

references.title: Curriculum preview flow
references.question: Q3
references.take: Captured three-step curriculum preview flow supports checking section order and lesson availability before sharing; it does not by itself prove a separate learner-role toggle.
